integrity: Analytic derivation and locally executed quadrature checks; neither the numerical tests nor the self-review represents independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Excludes the cone base disk and noncircular cones; fixed aperture strictly between 0 and 1; no uniform transition-window asymptotics. The metric cone cosine formula is prior work; priority of the evaluated endpoint coefficient requires independent bibliographic review.
title: Cubic diameter tails and a two-contact transition on finite circular cones
